data.dax_query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    "Total Invoice Amount", [Total Invoice Amount],
    "On-time %", [On-time %],
    "Overdue Invoices", [Overdue Invoices],
    "Invoice Count", [Invoice Count]
)

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'DimVendor'[Vendor Name],
    KEEPFILTERS(TOPN(10, ALL('DimVendor'[Vendor Name]), [Sum of Invoice Amount])),
    "Total Invoice Amount", [Total Invoice Amount]
)
ORDER BY 'DimVendor'[Vendor Name]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'FactInvoices'[Invoice Date Month Start],
    "Total Invoice Amount", [Total Invoice Amount],
    "On Time Paid Amount", [On Time Paid Amount]
)
ORDER BY 'FactInvoices'[Invoice Date Month Start]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'DimVendor'[Region],
    'FactInvoices'[Aging Bucket],
    "Sum of Invoice Amount", [Sum of Invoice Amount]
)
ORDER BY 'DimVendor'[Region], 'FactInvoices'[Aging Bucket]

EVALUATE

    'DimVendor'[Vendor Category],
    "Total Invoice Amount", [Total Invoice Amount],
    "On-time %", [On-time %],

    "Average of Days Late", [Average of Days Late]
)
ORDER BY 'DimVendor'[Vendor Category]

EVALUATE
